resolved_or_rejected_stage_findings.finding: Free-text contact safeguard was underspecified. F-01 is accepted and the final supplies a conservative reviewed projection.
The zero current Checks tab does not negate the historical merge count. The final correctly rejects that criticism.

nonmaterial_findings_and_limits.finding: Automerge conflict-view lifetime is not stated in final prose. The proposal keeps explicit application event history and does not make getConflicts a durable audit guarantee.

Known optional checkpoint and filtered-deletion conditions are less visible in final prose but remain in the complete source register/index. Neither concrete API nor filtered replication configuration is selected.
Browser/native platform, numeric photo budget and retention values remain undecided; this is appropriate user/implementation uncertainty, not performed validation.
Exclusive offline ownership is a refinement to the draft, not a literal promise made by it; correction labeling is broader than the quoted plan assumption.

critic_dispositions.note: Unreviewed free text is excluded; uncertain screening omits text and raw snippets are not returned.
Historical merge record and current Checks tab are different observations; no local test execution is claimed.
